lines.en: label futabafall:
scene newfall1
Another morning means another chance to hang around an attractive girl, and so I find myself where I have found myself on several occasions now-
lines.zh: 又一个早晨,意味着又一次能赖在漂亮女孩身边晃悠的机会,于是我又来到了这个近来已经来过好几次的地方-

lines.en: And probably even {i}more{/i} occasions in a life I can’t remember.
lines.zh: 而在我记不起来的那段人生里,恐怕来过的次数还要{i}更多{/i}。

lines.en: The only issue this time around is that the girl in question has yet to notice my presence and I have now been standing here for going on five minutes.
lines.zh: 这次唯一的问题是,那位当事人还没注意到我的存在,而我已经在这里站了快五分钟了。

lines.en: What’s even worse is that there are other people here. And seeing as Futaba is the only working volunteer, it has fallen on me to help all of the people she has ignored.
lines.zh: 更糟的是,这里还有别的人。而既然 Futaba 是唯一在岗的志愿者,替她打发所有被她无视掉的人这种事就落到了我头上。

lines.en: This may come as a surprise to you, but I am not very good at helping people.
lines.zh: 这可能会让你很意外,但我并不怎么擅长帮助别人。

lines.en: So I am sorry to everyone who I have misinformed today, but that is simply how things must be until I am able to snap the regular weekend librarian out of her daydream-induced stupor.
lines.zh: 所以我要向所有今天被我误导过的人道歉,不过在把这位常驻的周末图书管理员从白日梦引发的恍惚里拍醒之前,事情只能是这样。

lines.en: : Futaba, for the millionth time, good morning.
lines.zh: : Futaba,早上好,这话我都说到第一百万次了。

lines.en: Whatever is going on inside that head of hers must be pretty interesting if even hearing {i}my{/i} voice, the one she adores so much, is not enough to snap her out of it.
lines.zh: 她脑子里正在发生的事一定相当有趣,有趣到连听到{i}我的{/i}声音——她那么迷恋的声音——都不足以把她拉出来。

lines.en: But, then again, it might not be very interesting at all seeing as how every time I get caught in a daydream like that, one of my hands ends up inside of my pants.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来,也可能一点都不有趣,毕竟每次我陷入那种白日梦的时候,总有一只手会伸进裤子里。

lines.en: Futaba has yet to make such a move, unfortunately. And as much as it pains me to say this, I’d have to break her out of it if she did.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是,Futaba 还没做出这种举动。而且虽然我很不愿意这么说,但她要是真做了,我也只能把她打醒。

lines.en: I am all for the idea of watching her pleasure herself in the library, but doing so in a room full of other students would very likely not be a good move for me.
lines.zh: 在图书馆里看她自慰这个点子我完全赞成,可是在一间满是学生的屋子里这么做,对我来说恐怕不是什么好棋。

lines.en: So, what are some other things I can think about in the time between now and whenever Futaba wakes up?
lines.zh: 那么,从现在到 Futaba 醒过来这段时间里,我还能想点别的什么呢?

lines.en: Oh. The weather is nice today. Clouds are expected in the afternoon, with the morning being a bit on the colder side compared to the norm as of late.
lines.zh: 哦。今天天气不错。预计下午会有云,早晨比最近这些天要偏冷一些。

lines.en: The birds are chirping, the sun is shining, and I am still an incorrigible predator waiting to feast upon the flesh of an overly-developed teenage girl.
lines.zh: 鸟儿在叫,阳光正好,而我依然是个无可救药的捕食者,等着享用某个发育过度的少女的肉体。

lines.en: Good morning, world. I am here.
lines.zh: 早上好,世界。我来了。

lines.en: : Futaba. Please snap out of it before my thoughts start spiraling even further into the abyss.
lines.zh: : Futaba。趁我的思绪还没往深渊里越陷越深,赶紧醒过来吧。

lines.en: : Futaba. I really need-
lines.zh: : Futaba。我真的需要-

lines.en: scene newfall2
: Huh? Sensei? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 嗯?Sensei?怎么了?

lines.en: : And...how long have you been there exactly?
lines.zh: : 还有……你到底在那儿站了多久?

lines.en: : Probably ten minutes now. I was only a few more away from calling an ambulance.
lines.zh: : 大概十分钟了。再晚一点我就要叫救护车了。

lines.en: scene newfall3
: I’m so sorry, Sensei. I started reading a new book last night and...I suppose I may have started thinking about it while waiting for you to show up.
lines.zh: : 对不起,Sensei。我昨晚开始看一本新书,然后……我猜我可能是在等你来的时候就开始想那本书了。

lines.en: : Why not just...keep reading the book?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不干脆……继续看那本书?

lines.en: scene newfall4
: Because I left it at home.
lines.zh: : 因为我把书落家里了。

lines.en: : Futaba, this is a library. Just get another copy.
lines.zh: : Futaba,这里是图书馆。再拿一本不就行了。

lines.en: scene newfall5
: I’m okay with waiting until I get back home. It wouldn’t be right for me to spend my time getting absorbed in something when there are people here who need assistance.
lines.zh: : 我等回家再看也没关系。既然这里有需要帮助的人,我不该把时间花在沉浸于自己的事情上。

lines.en: : Yeah, about that. A bunch of people {i}have{/i} needed assistance and you kind of just ignored them.
lines.zh: : 嗯,说到这个。刚才有一堆人{i}需要{/i}帮助,而你基本都无视了。

lines.en: scene newfall6
: I...what?!
: Futaba, don’t yell. This is a library.
lines.zh: : Futaba,别喊。这里是图书馆。

lines.en: scene newfall7
: How...How many people have I ignored?
lines.zh: : 我……我无视了多少人?

lines.en: : I stopped counting after three.
lines.zh: : 过了三个我就懒得数了。

lines.en: : Why would you stop counting after such a low number?
lines.zh: : 为什么数到这么小的数字就不数了?

lines.en: : Why would you forsake your responsibility as a librarian and neglect your job? This is on you, not me.
lines.zh: : 你为什么背弃自己作为图书管理员的责任、玩忽职守?这是你的问题,不是我的。

lines.en: : Sensei...you...wouldn’t happen to know what time it is, would you?
lines.zh: : Sensei……你……该不会正好知道现在几点了吧?

lines.en: : Probably somewhere around 10:00 AM. I stopped keeping track of that as well.
lines.zh: : 大概上午十点左右。这个我也懒得算了。

lines.en: scene newfall6

lines.zh: : 上午十点?!

lines.en: : We’re still in the library, you know. People are trying to study and you have done nothing but make things harder for them today.
lines.zh: : 我们还在图书馆里,你知道吧。大家都在努力自习,而你今天一早上什么都没干,光给他们添麻烦了。

lines.en: scene newfall7
: I...haven’t even started reorganizing the shelves yet. And I promised I’d have the entire library done by noon...
lines.zh: : 我……连书架都还没开始整理。而且我答应过要在中午之前把整个图书馆弄完的……

lines.en: : Sensei...you...wouldn’t mind helping-
lines.zh: : Sensei……你……不介意帮-

lines.en: : Oh, no. I’ve already helped over three people today. If I wanted to help more than that, I’d just start volunteering here myself.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。我今天已经帮了三个以上的人了。要是我想帮更多,我干脆自己来这儿当志愿者算了。

lines.en: scene newfall8
: Hah...I suppose I’ll just have to stay later then. This is the price I must pay for letting my imagination run wild again.
lines.zh: : 哈……看来我只能晚点下班了。这就是我又一次任由想象力脱缰所必须付出的代价。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I’m not opposed to standing around and further preventing you from doing your job with continued conversation about what was going on in your head a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 如果这算安慰的话,我倒不介意继续站在这儿、继续用对话妨碍你干活,聊聊几分钟前你脑子里在想什么。

lines.en: scene newfall5
: At this point, I think that would be fine...I’m already going to have to stay late anyway, so having you around might actually make time go by a little faster.
lines.zh: : 事到如今,我觉得也没关系了……反正我都要留到很晚,有你在旁边说不定时间还过得快一点。

lines.en: : Then, by all means, start organizing your shelves or whatever it is you need to do while I transition back into the unhelpful burden of a man I am meant to be.
lines.zh: : 那就请便吧,开始整理你的书架还是干什么都行,我这就回归我本该扮演的那个没用的累赘男人。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba tears herself away from the desk, closing a notebook that only has a small handful of words scribbled into it, before making her way across the library.
lines.zh: Futaba 把自己从服务台前拽了起来,合上一个只潦草写了寥寥几个字的笔记本,然后穿过图书馆走去。

lines.en: I think to myself about whether or not she’d only gotten sucked into daydreaming because she was attempting to write, but ultimately ignore the thought as it doesn’t really interest me.
lines.zh: 我琢磨着她会不会是因为想写东西才陷入白日梦的,不过最后还是把这个念头抛开了,因为我其实并不感兴趣。

lines.en: scene newfall9
Unfortunately, the thought comes back just a few moments later when I can’t think of anything else to talk to Futaba about.
lines.zh: 不幸的是,几分钟后,当我想不出还能跟 Futaba 聊什么的时候,这个念头又回来了。

lines.en: : So...is everything okay, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 那么……一切都还好吗,Futaba?

lines.en: : Hm? Of course. Everything is completely fine, Sensei. I just get caught up in little daydreams like that from time to time. It’s nothing to worry over, really.
lines.zh: : 嗯?当然。一切都非常好,Sensei。我只是偶尔会陷进那种小小的白日梦里。真的没什么好担心的。

lines.en: : I saw you close a notebook before we got up. Were you trying to write something?
lines.zh: : 我刚才看到我们起身之前你合上了一个笔记本。你是在试着写点什么吗?

lines.en: scene newfall10
: That’s...um...well...
lines.zh: : 这个……嗯……那个……

lines.en: : To be honest, I’m not really sure how to put this...
lines.zh: : 说实话,我真的不知道该怎么说……

lines.en: : Are you...embarrassed to be caught writing or something?
lines.zh: : 你是……被人撞见在写东西觉得不好意思之类的?

lines.en: scene newfall11
: It’s less embarrassment about being caught writing and...more embarrassment about exactly {i}what{/i} I was writing.
lines.zh: : 与其说是被人撞见在写东西不好意思,不如说……是对我写的到底是{i}什么{/i}感到不好意思。

lines.en: : I’ve always had problems...coming up with my own stories, so...I often find myself just adding to stories made by other people.
lines.zh: : 我一直有个毛病……想不出属于自己的故事,所以……我经常只是给别人写的故事添枝加叶。

lines.en: : Like...writing unofficial sequels or something like that?
lines.zh: : 比如……写些非官方的续集之类的?

lines.en: : Kind of?...Not just sequels, but...side stories and...alternate scenarios and...things like that.
lines.zh: : 算是吧?……不只是续集,还有……外传啦……平行世界的情节啦……之类的。

lines.en: : There’s a term for it. {i}Fan fiction.{/i} But a lot of people frown upon it since it’s not entirely original and...the quality of a lot of it is...really, really bad.
lines.zh: : 这有个专门的叫法。{i}同人小说{/i}。不过很多人都不太看得上,因为它不完全是原创的,而且……其中很多作品的质量……真的非常、非常差。

lines.en: : I’m...sure that nothing I do really helps to...break that stigma, but...it keeps me occupied when I’m not actually reading.
lines.zh: : 我……相信我做的事大概也没能……打破这种偏见,不过……在不看书的时候,它至少能让我有点事做。

lines.en: scene newfall12
: W...What I’d really like to do is eventually come up with my own stories, though! From the ground up!
lines.zh: : 不……不过我真正想做的,是有一天能写出属于自己的故事!从零开始的那种!

lines.en: scene newfall13
: A good friend of mine from my old school does that...and she’s found a lot of success in...umm...{i}certain circles.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我在以前那所学校的一个好朋友就是这么做的……而且她在……嗯……{i}某些圈子{/i}里还挺成功的。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine I’ll ever be anywhere as good as her since she’s always been a sort of prodigy, but...I think it would be really nice to also be able to do something like that one day.
lines.zh: : 我大概永远也到不了她那个水平,毕竟她一直算是那种天才,不过……我觉得有一天自己也能做到那样的事,一定会很棒。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know anything about this fan fiction stuff, but I’m sure that you’d be able to write an original story if you actually apply yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我对同人小说这种东西一窍不通,但我相信只要你真的用心,你肯定能写出原创故事。

lines.en: : You certainly {i}read{/i} enough to know what would make a good book.
lines.zh: : 你{i}读{/i}的书够多了,自然知道什么能构成一本好书。

lines.en: scene newfall14
: I do...But, as I’m sure you know, reading and writing are two completely different beasts.
lines.zh: : 确实……不过,你也知道的,读和写是两码事。

lines.en: : And just because I read a lot doesn’t mean that I’ll be able to come up with an interesting story.
lines.zh: : 而且读得多并不意味着我就能想出有趣的故事。

lines.en: : That doesn’t, no. But what about whatever daydream you were having when I showed up?
lines.zh: : 这倒是不。不过我来的时候你正在做的那个白日梦呢?

lines.en: : That...daydream was another one of my...umm...alternate timelines ideas again...
lines.zh: : 那个……白日梦又是我的一个……嗯……平行时间线的点子……

lines.en: : Are they all like that?
lines.zh: : 全都是那样的吗?

lines.en: : All of them? No. I have plenty of original ones too. I just-
lines.zh: : 全部?不是。我也有不少原创的点子。我只是-

lines.en: : Then how about writing one of those?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不挑一个写下来?

lines.en: : If they’re interesting enough to tear you away from reality for ten minutes at a time, I’m sure there are plenty of other people who’d enjoy reading them as well.
lines.zh: : 如果它们有趣到能一次把你从现实里拽走十分钟,我相信肯定也有很多人会喜欢读它们。

lines.en: scene newfall15
: Well...yes. They’re interesting to me...But who’s to say that someone else will enjoy them as much as I do?
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。它们对我来说是有趣……可谁又能保证别人会像我一样喜欢呢?

lines.en: : Who’s to say literally anything in this life? Caring more about what others think about your work means nothing compared to what {i}you{/i} think about it.
lines.zh: : 这辈子谁又能保证什么呢?在意别人怎么看你的作品,远不如在意{i}你自己{/i}怎么看重要。

lines.en: : So what if no one else enjoys it? As long as you do, isn’t it worth the effort?
lines.zh: : 所以就算没人喜欢又怎样?只要你自己喜欢,不就值得一试吗?

lines.en: scene newfall16
Futaba pauses for a moment as blood begins to pool in her cheeks and I think about how strange it is that words alone can influence the fluids inside of a person’s body.
lines.zh: Futaba 顿了一下,血色开始在她的脸颊上聚集,我想,光是几句话就能影响一个人身体里的液体,真是奇妙。

lines.en: I wonder if her words will ever do that for someone else?
lines.zh: 我在想,她的文字有朝一日会不会也对别人产生同样的效果?

lines.en: And I wonder what type of words they would be.
lines.zh: 也在想,那会是什么样的文字。

lines.en: : You’re...
lines.zh: : 你好……

lines.en: : You’re so cool...
lines.zh: : 你好厉害……

lines.en: : Thanks, Futaba. I try.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Futaba。我尽力而为。

lines.en: scene newfall17
: Oh! Uhh...haha! I didn’t really mean to say that out loud...but I guess it just kind of slipped out.
lines.zh: : 哦!呃……哈哈!我真的不是故意说出口的……不过好像就这么溜出来了。

lines.en: scene newfall18
: That was...a really inspiring thing to say, though...But I guess if anyone was going to be able to give me the push I needed, it would be you.
lines.zh: : 不过……那真是一番很鼓舞人心的话……不过想想也是,如果说有谁能给我我需要的那一点推力,那一定是你。

lines.en: : I’m sure it won’t be the last time I push you. In fact, what if I give you a little assignment to push you even further?
lines.zh: : 我相信这不会是最后一次我推你一把。事实上,不如我给你布置一个小作业,再推你一步?

lines.en: scene newfall19
: An assignment?
lines.zh: : 作业?

lines.en: : Yeah. Take one of those original daydreams of yours and try turning it into a full-fledged story. The kind without characters who already exist in properties owned by other people.
lines.zh: : 对。挑一个你原创的白日梦,试着把它写成一个完整的故事。那种不带别人作品里已有角色的。

lines.en: : I’ll read it and give you my honest thoughts along with any criticism I may have.
lines.zh: : 我会读,然后给你我最真实的想法,以及可能有的批评意见。

lines.en: : You...would really go out of your way for me like that?
lines.zh: : 你……真的愿意为我做到这种地步?

lines.en: : Sure.  Writing is a mutated reflection of a person’s innermost self.
lines.zh: : 当然。写作是一个人内在自我的变形倒影。

lines.en: : The more you put on paper, the more I’ll understand you.
lines.zh: : 你写在纸上的越多,我就会越了解你。

lines.en: And the more I understand you, the closer we’ll become.
lines.zh: 而我越了解你,我们就会越亲近。

lines.en: scene newfall20
: And if it’s not good?...
lines.zh: : 那如果写得不好呢?……

lines.en: : If I can’t write something that...serves as a reflection...will that ruin your chances of ever {i}understanding{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 如果我写不出能……充当那种倒影的东西……会不会让你永远都没机会{i}了解{/i}我?

lines.en: : No clue. I can’t predict the future.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。我又不能预测未来。

lines.en: : I just don’t think it’s fair to hold yourself back from something you want to do just because you’re afraid of what other people would think.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得,因为害怕别人怎么想就放弃自己想做的事,这对你不公平。

lines.en: : Especially when one of those {i}other people{/i} is standing right in front of you, telling you to go for it.
lines.zh: : 尤其是当那个『{i}别人{/i}』就站在你面前,叫你放手去做的时候。

lines.en: scene newfall21
Futaba locks eyes with me in disagreement with what the pools of blood inside her cheeks would have her do.
lines.zh: Futaba 与我四目相对,她不同意她脸颊里那两滩血要她做的事。

lines.en: She pushes back, but her words do not influence my bodily fluids the way mine influenced hers.
lines.zh: 她反驳了,可她的言语并没有像我的言语影响她的体液那样影响我的体液。

lines.en: : Okay...
: I’ll do it. I’ll start writing something. Something original.
lines.zh: : 我会写的。我会开始写点东西。原创的东西。

lines.en: : I want you to understand me a little better, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想让你多了解我一点,Sensei。

lines.en: : I want to write something you can be proud of.
lines.zh: : 我想写出能让你骄傲的东西。

lines.en: : I had a feeling you’d say that.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会这么说。

lines.en: : I won’t give you a due date or anything, obviously. You’re free to do this at your own leisure. And if you need any suggestions or help with anything, feel free to ask.
lines.zh: : 我当然不会给你定截止日期什么的。你可以按自己的节奏慢慢来。如果需要什么建议或者帮助,尽管开口。

lines.en: : Just don’t tell any of the other girls about this since I am absolutely giving you special treatment right now.
lines.zh: : 只是别跟其他女生说这事,因为我现在绝对是在给你特殊待遇。

lines.en: : Can I...or...umm...
lines.zh: : 我能……或者……嗯……

lines.en: scene newfall22
: Is it okay if I ask...{i}why{/i} you’re giving me special treatment?...
lines.zh: : 我能问一下……你{i}为什么{/i}给我特殊待遇吗?……

lines.en: Her blood wins out in the end.
lines.zh: 最后还是她的血赢了。

lines.en: She turns away.
lines.zh: 她转过身去。

lines.en: : I don’t really have a reason for it.
lines.zh: : 我也说不上什么理由。

lines.en: : I guess I just have a soft spot for girls who write.
lines.zh: : 大概就是我对会写东西的女生没什么抵抗力吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : I’ll do my best to become one of those girls.
lines.zh: : 我会努力成为那样的女生。

lines.en: I don’t stay around for much longer as Futaba still has a decent amount of work to do and my presence has all but prevented her from getting {i}anything{/i} done at all.
lines.zh: 我没再待太久,因为 Futaba 还有不少活要干,而我的存在几乎让她{i}什么{/i}都干不成。

lines.en: As such, I take my leave and begin to look for something else to do with the rest of my day.
lines.zh: 于是我告辞离开,开始琢磨今天剩下的时间该干点什么。

lines.en: I have no idea what Futaba will manage to create...or even if it will be any good.
lines.zh: 我不知道 Futaba 到底能写出什么……甚至不知道那东西会不会好。

lines.en: But at least she’s going to try.
lines.zh: 但至少,她要去试了。

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 1
$ futabafall = True
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
label futabafallx:
scene black
scene futabafall5

lines.zh: : 好痛……

lines.en: I quickly kneel down beside Futaba to make sure she’s still alive. Once I confirm she is, my mind navigates elsewhere.
lines.zh: 我赶紧跪到 Futaba 身边,确认她还活着。一确认完,我的思绪就飘到别处去了。

lines.en: Ahh, pantyhose. What a wonderful invention.
lines.zh: 啊,连裤袜。多么伟大的发明。

lines.en: Though, I have to say, I think I’d prefer her without them at this particular moment in time.
lines.zh: 不过我得说,此时此刻我还是更希望她没穿。

lines.en: But nonetheless, this is an image I will ingrain into my mind.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样,这个画面我都会在脑子里刻下来。

lines.en: scene futabafall6
: Sensei...You scared me...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你吓到我了……

lines.en: : Sorry. I didn’t even realize you were here. I thought you had
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我都没注意到你在这儿。我还以为你

lines.en: off when I didn’t see you at the front desk."
lines.zh: 走掉了,前台没看到你。"

lines.en: : Are you okay? That was quite the fall.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗?摔得可真不轻。

lines.en: scene futabafall7
: I think so. My butt kind of hurts but other than that I think I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得还行。屁股有点疼,不过除此之外应该没事。

lines.en: : Want me to rub it for you?
lines.zh: : 要我帮你揉揉吗?

lines.en: scene futabafall8
: Huh?! M-my-my??
lines.zh: : 哈?!我、我、我的??

lines.en: : Relax. I’m just kidding.
lines.zh: : 放松。我开玩笑的。

lines.en: scene futabafall7
: {i}What kind of joke is that?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这算什么玩笑啊?……{/i}

lines.en: : You should really be careful from now on, you know. If you landed on your neck you could have died.
lines.zh: : 你以后真得小心点,知道吗。要是你脖子着地,可能就没命了。

lines.en: : I know, I know...This happens so often that you’d think I’d be prepared for it by now.
lines.zh: : 我知道,我知道……这种事发生得那么频繁,你大概以为我早就该有准备了。

lines.en: : How often do you fall off stepladders? I can’t imagine this being a majorly recurring event.
lines.zh: : 你多经常从梯凳上摔下来?我实在想象不出这会是什么常发生的事。

lines.en: scene futabafall8
: I don’t mean just stepladders, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我当然不只是指梯凳。

lines.en: : I’m just sort of clumsy in general...
lines.zh: : 我就是总体上有点笨手笨脚……

lines.en: scene futabafall10
: That’s nothing to feel bad about. We all have our moments.
lines.zh: : 这没什么好难为情的。谁都有这种时候。

lines.en: : This one time in [high_school], I tripped and knocked over an
lines.zh: : 有一次在[high_school],我绊了一跤,打翻了

lines.en: entire case of dead frogs during a science lab."
lines.zh: 整整一箱死青蛙,就在生物实验室里。"

lines.en: : Then to make things worse, the teacher slipped on one and landed flat on her face.
lines.zh: : 更糟的是,老师踩在其中一个上面滑倒了,脸朝下摔在地上。

lines.en: scene futabafall11
: That’s...kind of gross...
lines.zh: : 那……有点恶心……

lines.en: : I know, right? What was even grosser was that she broke three
lines.zh: : 就是说啊。更恶心的是她还摔断了三颗

lines.en: of her teeth and needed facial reconstruction surgery."
lines.zh: 牙,得去做面部重建手术。"

lines.en: scene futabafall9
: Is this...supposed to make me feel better?
lines.zh: : 这……是为了让我好受一点吗?

lines.en: : Depends. Is it working?
lines.zh: : 看情况。管用吗?

lines.en: scene futabafall12
: Hmm...Maybe just a little.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许有一点点吧。

lines.en: : Well I’m glad. Because none of that story was true and now I feel bad about lying to you.
lines.zh: : 那我就放心了。因为那个故事没有一句是真的,现在我为自己骗了你感到内疚。

lines.en: scene futabafall13
: You made all of that up off the top of your head?
lines.zh: : 你全是当场现编的?

lines.en: : Yeah. I didn’t know where I was going with it at first but it just sort of filled itself in.
lines.zh: : 是啊。一开始我也不知道要往哪儿说,结果它自己就填满了。

lines.en: scene futabafall12
: I guess that’s to be expected from someone like you.
lines.zh: : 换成你这样的人,这也算是意料之中吧。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思?

lines.en: scene futabafall10
: N-Nothing in particular...Just that you’re really smart and creative and stuff.
lines.zh: : 没……没什么特别的意思……就是说你真的很聪明、很有创造力什么的。

lines.en: : I wish I could be as creative as you.
lines.zh: : 我要是能像你一样有创造力就好了。

lines.en: : Oh come on, I’m sure you can do a million times better than some dead frogs and a messed up teacher.
lines.zh: : 得了吧,我相信你能比几只死青蛙和一位惨兮兮的老师强上一百万倍。

lines.en: "Hmm...Now that I think about it, I remember Sensei saying something
lines.zh: "嗯……这么一想,我记得 Sensei 在他的那本日记里

lines.en: about how Futaba gets caught in daydreams in that journal of his."
lines.zh: 提过,Futaba 经常会陷入白日梦。"

lines.en: Maybe I can talk to her about those?
lines.zh: 也许我可以跟她聊聊那些?

lines.en: : Say, you daydream a lot, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 话说,你经常做白日梦吧?

lines.en: scene futabafall14
: I never really noticed.
lines.zh: : 我还真没注意过。

lines.en: : Yup. You zone out in class every once in a while. It’s not a big deal, though.
lines.zh: : 有啊。你在课上偶尔会发呆。不过这没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : What I’m getting at is why not try turning those daydreams into something creative?
lines.zh: : 我想说的是,为什么不试着把这些白日梦变成有创意的东西呢?

lines.en: scene futabafall13
: Do you mean like...writing a book?
lines.zh: : 你是说像……写一本书?

lines.en: : Sure. A book, poetry, maybe even painting.
lines.zh: : 对。书也好,诗也好,说不定画画也行。

lines.en: scene futabafall7
: I’m not really that good with my hands...I don’t think painting would work out.
lines.zh: : 我的手不太巧……我觉得画画大概不行。

lines.en: : Well then how about one of the first two? I could help you if you need it.
lines.zh: : 那前两个怎么样?需要的话我可以帮你。

lines.en: : It’ll be my way of apologizing for inadvertently causing you to fall off a stepladder and flash me.
lines.zh: : 就当是我为间接害你从梯凳上摔下来、还走光给我看而赔罪吧。

lines.en: scene futabafall14
: Flash you?
lines.zh: : 走光?

lines.en: : You...are aware that I can see up your skirt, correct?
lines.zh: : 你……知道我能看见你裙子里面对吧?

lines.en: scene futabafall8
Ah, I guess she didn’t realize it after all.
lines.zh: 啊,看来她果然没意识到。

lines.en: scene library
show futabacdisappointed
: Why didn’t you say anything sooner?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不早点说?

lines.en: Who in their right mind would do such a thing?
lines.zh: 脑子正常的人谁会干这种事?

lines.en: show futabacembarrassed
: I’m sorry you had to see me that way...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉让你看到我那个样子……

lines.en: : There’s no need to apologize. It’s not like I could really see your underwear through the pantyhose.
lines.zh: : 没必要道歉。隔着连裤袜,我又看不清你的内裤。

lines.en: show futabacembarrassedsmile
: I don’t think that’s the issue here...
lines.zh: : 我觉得问题不在这里吧……

lines.en: : So, what do you say about the whole ‘harnessing your creative vision' thing?
lines.zh: : 那关于『把你创造力发挥出来』这事,你觉得怎么样?

lines.en: : I didn’t hear an answer before you started collecting yourself.
lines.zh: : 你刚才收拾自己的时候,我还没听到回答呢。

lines.en: show futabaccurious
: Do...you really think I can?
lines.zh: : 你……真的觉得我可以吗?

lines.en: : Well you won’t know until you try, right?
lines.zh: : 不试试怎么知道,对吧?

lines.en: : You’ve really never tried writing a book or poem or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 你真的从来没试着写过书、诗之类的东西?

lines.en: show futabacembarrassedsmile
: Well, of course I’ve tried, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯,我当然试过,可是……

lines.en: : Nothing ever really comes out how I want it to.
lines.zh: : 写出来的东西从来都不是我想要的样子。

lines.en: : Well then let me help you. I’m your teacher.
lines.zh: : 那就让我来帮你吧。我是你的老师。

lines.en: Or, at least I’m {i}pretending{/i} to be your teacher. I don’t really think I’m qualified...
lines.zh: 或者说,我是在{i}假装{/i}当你的老师。我真不觉得自己够格……

lines.en: show futabacraisedbrow
: But...aren’t you busy with the rest of the class?
lines.zh: : 可是……你不用管班上其他人吗?

lines.en: : You’re just as important as everyone else, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你和其他所有人一样重要,Futaba。

lines.en: show futabacsurprised
: Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了?

lines.en: : No, I’m just-
lines.zh: : 没事,我只是-

lines.en: show futabacraisedbrow
: ...Not really used to hearing you call me by my first name yet.
lines.zh: : ……只是还不怎么习惯你直接叫我的名字。

lines.en: show futabachappy
: Heh~ It’s kind of like we’re real friends...
lines.zh: : 呵呵~感觉我们像真正的朋友一样……

lines.en: : That’s right. And friends help each other out when they need us.
lines.zh: : 没错。而朋友会在彼此需要的时候互相帮忙。

lines.en: : And so as your teacher {i}and{/i} your friend, I’m giving you an extra homework assignment.
lines.zh: : 所以,作为你的老师{i}兼{/i}朋友,我要给你布置一份额外的作业。

lines.en: show futabaccurious
: Extra homework? What do I need to do?
lines.zh: : 额外的作业?我需要做什么?

lines.en: : Write me something. Anything. A poem, a short story...But it needs to be about something you feel.
lines.zh: : 写点东西给我。什么都可以。一首诗,一篇短篇……但必须是关于你有所感受的东西。

lines.en: : It can be a daydream, a secret, whatever. But I’m going to need it done by Affection level 10.
lines.zh: : 可以是一个白日梦,一个秘密,什么都行。不过我需要在好感度 10 级之前拿到它。

lines.en: show futabacsurprised
: By...when?
lines.zh: : 在……什么时候之前?

lines.en: : Sorry. I meant to say that I need it done soon.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我的意思是,我需要你尽快写完。

lines.en: show futabachappy
: Hehe~ Okay. I’ll do it. I can’t promise it will be any good, though.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~好的。我会写的。不过我不敢保证会写得很好。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba and I spend the next few minutes cleaning up the books she knocked over when she fell.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟里,我和 Futaba 一起收拾她摔倒时撞翻的书。

lines.en: Before I know it, I’m heading back outside to get on with my day...
lines.zh: 不知不觉,我已经走回室外,继续过我这一天了……

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 1
$ futabafall = True
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
